name: Waga Seishun no Youkai Yashiki
source:
A group of four people get locked into a mansion full of youkai. They travel together to find a way out.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
4个人被困在一座妖怪横行的宅邸中。他们结伴探索，寻找逃出生天的方法。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
